links.comparator_used: Certified human grader without DL assistance (Model 1), with all models compared against an expert ophthalmologist gold standard
links.outcome: Agreement with gold standard (weighted kappa), sensitivity and specificity for any DR, and NPV and PPV extrapolated to 23.8% prevalence
links.effect: Autonomous DL (Model 3) vs human grader (Model 1): weighted kappa 0.72 vs 0.88; sensitivity 78% vs 95%; specificity 81% vs 82%; PPV 57% vs 63%; NPV 92% vs 98%
links.tradeoff: Autonomous DL errors: incorrect detection of artefacts (n=49), missed microaneurysms (n=26), and inconsistencies between segmentation and classification (n=51).
links.quote: As compared to the gold standard, weighted kappa for Models 1-3 was 0.88, 0.89 and 0.72, sensitivities were 95%, 94% and 78% and specificities were 82%, 84% and 81%.
